GenMedia Creative Studio is an app that highlights the capabilities

post.description:
Uploads a new source asset. Handles de-duplication and upscaling.
Accepts multipart/form-data.

- **scope**: (Admin only) Set the asset's scope. Defaults to 'private'.
- **workspace_id**: The ID of the workspace to upload the asset to.
- **assetType**: Set the asset's type. Defaults to 'generic_image'.

Accepts any image file, converts it to PNG, and returns the binary data.
Used for pre-processing unsupported formats before cropping on the frontend.

Creates a new private workspace for the currently authenticated user.
The creator is automatically assigned as the 'OWNER'.

post.summary: Invite a User to a Workspace
post.description:
Invites a user (by email) to join a specific workspace with a given role.

This action is restricted to the workspace's OWNER or a system ADMIN.
It performs a dual-write, updating both the workspace's member list
and the invited user's list of workspace memberships.

post.summary: Get a Signed URL for Direct PDF Upload
post.description:
Generates a secure, short-lived URL that the client can use to upload a
brand guideline PDF directly to Google Cloud Storage.

This endpoint is called *after* the client has successfully uploaded the
PDF to the GCS signed URL.

It creates the placeholder document in Firestore and triggers the
asynchronous background job to process the PDF from GCS.

get.summary: Get the Brand Guideline for a Workspace
get.description:
Retrieves the unique brand guideline associated with a specific workspace.

Returns a 404 error if no guideline has been created for the workspace yet.

Retrieves a single brand guideline by its unique ID.

- Any authenticated user can view global guidelines.
- Only members of a workspace can view its specific guidelines.

delete.description:
Deletes a brand guideline and all of its associated assets (e.g., PDF chunks in GCS).

- Only the workspace owner or a system admin can delete a workspace-specific guideline.
- Only a system admin can delete a global guideline.

src__common__schema__media_item_model__S.title: SourceMediaItemLink
src__common__schema__media_item_model__S.description:
A linking object within MediaItemModel that connects a generated result
to a specific previously generated media item (from the 'media_library' collection)
and specifies its function in the new creation.
